title: COLES IS ON THE LEFT
content: Has anyone had a dream of a mall like this? If you procoeed down one of the halls/pathways (a dead end) You will see the Coles, the supermarket, is on the left, and a department store is on the right, (similar to the first and second image that I attached). If you walk backwards a bit, on your right, you will find a store. This store is biege/faded yellow in color, and sells various products, from stuff you would see in a DAISO store to an asian supermarket store. The person that runs this establishment is an old woman, I only know her by the name "Granny". She appears often as an stereotypical asian old woman, who might also be caucasian. Sometimes, her granddaughter takes over running the store. Her granddaughter is around 16-18, wears an apron, and sometimes a hijab. Has anyone came across this specific location in their dreams? Any help would be appreciated, thank you. (please, no troll replies, this is a serious matter. I have business to settle with these people.)
